notes: This contract records the next private IEEE 1516.1-2025 temporal-coordinator slice. FederationTimeCoordinator binds the selected official LogicalTime implementation, retains pending TSO entries, models callback work as in-transit, retains completed timestamps until the recipient's next logical-time advance, and removes all recipient-owned temporal state on resignation. FederationTimeExecutionSnapshot carries those three states into the GALT/LITS calculator: delivered-since-last-advance and queued/in-transit timestamps participate in GALT, while future queued/in-transit timestamps participate in LITS. The private registry hooks are test-only kernel boundaries; no public timestamped Send Interaction, Update Attribute Values, Delete Object Instance, Retract, time-advance variant, transport, JUnit evidence, protected review, package result, or conformance claim is made.
